entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-09-29
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • IDE0058 fires for null propogation assignment #80499
  • Correctly pass environment variables to compiler server #80497
  • `[param: NotNull]` on property set accessor not respected for nullability analysis #80496
  • Data section string literals are limited to 65535 unique strings #80494
    Next
  • CA1508 false positive: "Avoid dead conditional code" incorrectly flags condition in multiple catch clause with exit scenarios #80488

Closed

  • Missing return in top-level statements squiggles the entire file #80487
    Backlog

PullRequests

Created

  • Block file-local EmbeddedAttribute definitions. #80501
    Area-Compilers
  • Fix crash getting options for a diagnostic suppressor #80500
    Area-Analyzers
  • Fix thread safety issue in BuildServerConnection.TryCreateServer environment variable handling #80498
  • WIP: Add support for `with(...)` elements in collection expressions. #80495
    Needs API Review
  • WIP: Dict/Collection-args #80491
    Area-Compilers, Needs API Review, VSCode

Merged

  • Improve diagnostic location for top-level-program with a reachable end #80490
    Area-Compilers, Next
  • Extension block members do not have `this` parameter #80457
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Extension Everything, Next
  • Handle some scenarios where attributes applied in local functions or lambdas within extension blocks were missing in metadata #80464
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Extension Everything, Next
  • Fix a few Replay issues #80486
    Next
  • [main] Unset other DOTNET_ROOT env vars when launching apphosts #80492
    Next
  • [release/dev18.0] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #80489

Updated

  • Final mop-up for the diagnostic offset fixing and cleaning pass. #80394
    Area-Compilers
  • Initial spike for file-based programs editor features DLL #80410
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • Improve diagnostic quality for less accessible base type argument #80483
    Area-Compilers, Community
  • Add comprehensive GitHub Copilot instructions for .NET Roslyn repository #80123
  • Disambiguate extension methods in "ambiguous call" error message when they have the same name but are from different assemblies #80453
    Area-Compilers
  • Add followup async public apis #80455
    Area-Compilers, Needs API Review, Feature - Runtime Async
  • Extensions: refine tracking of used imports #80485
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Extension Everything
  • Fix Color Color const field initialization accessing the Color type #68283
    Area-Compilers, Community, untriaged, Backlog
  • MS.CA.VB resources cleanup #80098
    Area-Compilers, Community
  • More MS.CA.CSharp resource cleanup #80100
    Area-Compilers, Community
